content_of_post_to_comment: It's funny, I was baffled by the “nobody likes short stories” discourse because I genuinely love short stories and read multiple anthologies per year. But then it occurred to me that they're all sci-fi and fantasy short stories, and that whenever I venture outside that my appetite for them practically disappears. But like gimme 4000 words about a sad robot who wants to die or a guy who smuggles computers that turn you French and I'm golden
